title: Local differential bounds give global finite-jet Fitting bounds
statement: Let $k,R,X,p_i,B_i$ be as follows: $k$ is a field [def-weil-field], $R=k[[t]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], $X/k$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], has dimension at most one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and is lci [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]. The $p_i$, indexed by $\operatorname{Fin}r$, are distinct closed points and $X/k$ is smooth off their range [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Each $B_i$ is a local flat essentially finite type $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map, def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra] with its induced $k$-algebra structure. Suppose a finite free surjection $\pi_i:B_i^{m_i}\twoheadrightarrow\Omega_{B_i/R}$ and an exponent $e_i$ satisfy $t^{e_i}\in\operatorname{Fit}_{a_i}(\Omega_{B_i/R})$, where $a_i=\dim\mathcal O_{X,p_i}+\operatorname{trdeg}_k\kappa(p_i)$, using the kernel-minor convention [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-independence-base-change]. Let $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ be flat, locally finitely presented and H-projective [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation, def-kun-projective], with $e:Y_k\simeq X$ over $k$. For every $n\geq0$ suppose given $j_n:X\to Y_{n+1}$ over the special-fibre inclusion and local isomorphisms $\mathcal O_{Y_{n+1},j_n(p_i)}\simeq B_i/(t^{n+1})$ preserving base scalars, where $Y_{n+1}=Y\times_R\operatorname{Spec}(R/(t^{n+1}))$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then there are opens $U_0,U_1$ covering $Y$, with proper restricted morphisms $g_d$, whose special fibres have pure dimension $d$ [def-weil-pure-dimension] and have depth equal to stalk Krull dimension at all points. For each $d=0,1$ there is $n\geq1$ such that $t^{n-1}$ belongs globally to $\operatorname{Fit}_d(\Omega_{(U_d)_n/(R/(t^n))})$ [def-trf-fitting-ideal-sheaf]. The global section means the pullback of the scalar $t^{n-1}\bmod t^n$, with membership in the ideal on the whole source open. This is a calculation on an already given family, not an existence or generic-smoothness assertion. Empty marked lists and empty pieces are included.

proof.text: Apply lci Cohen--Macaulayness to all stalks of X and transport depth and dimension to the special fibre using the given special-fibre isomorphism. Transport its topological dimension bound by the induced homeomorphism. Reuse the proved special-fibre and depth-transport helpers from the finite-jet criterion module; its generic-smoothness theorem is not invoked here.

The fibre CM locus is open and contains the special fibre. Properness over the local power-series base forces it to be all of Y. Apply the relative fibre-dimension open partition. Pairwise disjoint open pieces covering Y are clopen. Local dimension of the special fibre is at most one, so the union of the zero and one pieces contains the special fibre and hence equals Y by properness. Their inclusions are closed immersions, so each restricted morphism is proper.

The special fibres of the restricted pieces map by open immersions into the full special fibre; their stalks have the same depth and dimension. The special-fibre-to-point-fibre isomorphisms and open immersions preserve local topological dimension, which the partition fixes to i.val. Constant local dimension on these locally Noetherian special fibres gives pure dimension.

Take E to be the sum of the finite list of local exponents. Each exponent is at most E; multiply the given member by t^{E-ex_i} and use the ideal property to obtain uniform bounds t^E. Apply isolated_curve_local_fitting_bounds to the proper pure pieces just constructed, retaining the original scalar-compatible local jet comparisons and prescribed finite presentation bounds. Combine the resulting finite-jet membership with the cover, properness, CM and purity proved above. The lower lemma gives the jet at the explicit exponent E+1; provide this witness, prove positivity, and simplify (E+1)-1=E.

theorem isolated_curve_local_fitting_criterion
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (1 : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hlci : ∃ (I : Type u) (A : I → CommRingCat.{u})
      (aA : ∀ i, Algebra k (A i)) (ft : ∀ i, Algebra.FiniteType k (A i))
      (φ : ∀ i, Spec (A i) ⟶ X),
      (∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (φ i)) ∧
        (∀ i, φ i ≫ f =
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (@algebraMap k (A i) _ _ (aA i)))) ∧
        (∀ x : X, ∃ i, ∃ y : Spec (A i), φ i y = x) ∧
        (∀ i, @Algebra.IsLocalCompleteIntersection k (A i) _ _ (aA i) (ft i)))
    (r : ℕ) (p : Fin r → X) (hp : Function.Injective p)
    (hclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed ({p i} : Set X))
    (hsmooth : ∀ x ∉ Set.range p, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ Smooth (U.ι ≫ f))
    (B : Fin r → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (B i)] [∀ i, IsLocalRing (B i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra (PowerSeries k) (B i)] [∀ i, Algebra k (B i)]
    [∀ i, IsScalarTower k (PowerSeries k) (B i)]
    [∀ i, Module.Flat (PowerSeries k) (B i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra.EssFiniteType (PowerSeries k) (B i)]
    (ex : Fin r → ℕ) (m : Fin r → ℕ)
    (π : ∀ i, (Fin (m i) → B i) →ₗ[B i] KaehlerDifferential (PowerSeries k) (B i))
    (hπ : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (π i))
    (hbound : ∀ i,
      let : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk (p i)) :=
        (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top ≫
          X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (p i) trivial).hom.toAlgebra)
      (algebraMap (PowerSeries k) (B i) PowerSeries.X) ^ ex i ∈
        (π i).presentationFittingIdeal
          ((WithBot.unbotD 0 (ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (p i)))).toNat +
            (Algebra.trdeg k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (p i)))).toNat))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of (PowerSeries k)))
    [Flat g] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g] [IsHProjective g]
    (e : pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k)))) ≅ X)
    (he : e.hom ≫ f = pullback.snd g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k)))))
    (j : ∀ n, X ⟶ pullback g (formalCurveBaseι k n))
    (hj : ∀ n, j n ≫ pullback.fst g (formalCurveBaseι k n) =
      e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k)))))
    (h : ∀ i n,
      (pullback g (formalCurveBaseι k n)).presheaf.stalk (j n (p i))
        ≃+* (B i ⧸ Ideal.span
          {(algebraMap (PowerSeries k) (B i) PowerSeries.X) ^ (n + 1)}))
    (hscalar : ∀ i n a, h i n (isolatedCurveScalarToStalk
      (pullback.snd g (formalCurveBaseι k n)) (j n (p i))
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap _ _ a)) :
    ∃ U : Fin 2 → Y.Opens, (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤ ∧
      (∀ i, IsProper ((U i).ι ≫ g)) ∧
      (∀ i, ∀ x : ↥(pullback ((U i).ι ≫ g) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k))))),
        (IsLocalRing.depth
          (R := (pullback ((U i).ι ≫ g) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k))))).presheaf.stalk x)
          ((pullback ((U i).ι ≫ g) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k))))).presheaf.stalk x) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
        ringKrullDim ((pullback ((U i).ι ≫ g) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k))))).presheaf.stalk x)) ∧
      (∀ i, (pullback ((U i).ι ≫ g) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k))))).IsPureDimension i.val) ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧
        (pullback.snd ((U i).ι ≫ g) (Scheme.powerSeriesJetBaseMap k n)).appTop
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of ((PowerSeries k) ⧸
            Ideal.span {(PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries k) ^ n}))).inv
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ ((PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries k) ^ (n - 1)))) ∈
        (Scheme.Modules.fittingIdealSheaf
          (pullback.snd ((U i).ι ≫ g) (Scheme.powerSeriesJetBaseMap k n)).relativeDifferentials
            i.val).idealOfOpens ⊤)
